items.quote: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;
items.claim: The text asks God Almighty to bless the person addressed, make them fruitful and multiply them so they become a multitude of people.

items.quote: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.
items.claim: The text passes the blessing of Abraham to the addressee and his descendants, so that he may inherit the land where he is a stranger, a land the text says God gave to Abraham.
items.action: give the blessing of Abraham; grant inheritance of land
items.object: the land wherein thou art a stranger
items.mechanism: inherited covenant blessing passed down from Abraham
items.place: the land wherein thou art a stranger (not named in the text)
